home.lead: Hold a credential from a trusted issuer, generate an UltraHonk zero-knowledge proof locally, and verify your claim on Stellar — without the underlying data ever touching the chain.

issue.title: Issue
issue.body: A trusted issuer signs a credential to your wallet. It lives on your device — never on a server.

prove.title: Prove
prove.body: Generate a zero-knowledge proof locally in your browser. Only the claim leaves; the data behind it never does.

verifyStep.title: Verify
verifyStep.body: Any Stellar protocol reads ProofRegistry on-chain. One proof, valid across every protocol, for 30 days.

home.trustedLead: Any protocol on Stellar can verify your credentials in one contract call. No API. No backend. No re-verification.
home.directBody: Visit StellarCred before using any app. Your credentials work everywhere, instantly.
home.throughAppBody: Apps that integrate StellarCred show a "Verify" button. Complete verification and return automatically.
home.devFeature3Body: On-chain proof, read in one call. No backend needed.
home.ctaBody: Connect a Freighter wallet on testnet, get a credential, generate your first on-chain ZK proof in under a minute.

holder.title: Your credentials
holder.emptyBody: Get a credential from a trusted issuer, then generate a zero-knowledge proof to verify it on-chain.
holder.connectWalletToProve: Connect a wallet to generate and submit proofs.
holder.proofFirstRun: First run loads the WASM prover (~5–15 s)
holder.confirmedBody: Your claim is live on Stellar for {days} days — without revealing the data behind it.

verify.title: Get verified
verify.connectWallet: Connect your wallet to request credentials for your address.
verify.redirectingToWallet: Credential saved — redirecting to your wallet…
verify.kycNote: You'll be taken to a secure identity verification flow. No personal data is stored by StellarCred.
verify.poseidonNote: Each claim is committed with Poseidon2 and stays private. You prove a statement about it — never the underlying value.
verify.balancePrivacy: Your exact balance is never stored or revealed on-chain — only this threshold is public.

issuer.title: Issue a credential
issuer.simulationNote: In production this would be a separate authenticated app run by the institution — KYC provider, bank, employer — after verifying the holder off-chain. The holder would never see this interface.
issuer.connectIssuerNote: Connect the registered issuer wallet to issue.
issuer.poseidonAttr: The attribute is committed with Poseidon2 and stays private — the holder proves a claim about it.
issuer.poseidonSecret: A fresh secret is generated and committed with Poseidon2 — the holder proves it without revealing it.
issuer.emptyIssuer: Issue a credential to generate signed JSON. It is saved to this browser's wallet and ready to prove on the Holder page — we never store it server-side.

apps.title: Demo protocols
apps.subtitle: Any protocol, any claim.
apps.returnedFrom: You were returned here from StellarCred automatically.
apps.connectToCheck: Connect your wallet to check eligibility.
apps.noPersonalData: {name} read ProofRegistry.check_claim and found valid proofs for your address. No personal data was shared.
apps.noPersonalDataDenied: {name} only reads ProofRegistry.check_claim for your address — it never sees the credential data behind your proofs.

docs.title: About StellarCred
docs.lead: Zero-knowledge credential infrastructure on Stellar. Prove facts about yourself without the data ever touching the chain.
